decision: Probe D1/D2 first using staging and six coordinators, two short sessions each. All probes preserve privacy/center authorization, documented CSV and concurrent entry; share six engineer-days and existing hosting. Verify split-center isolation: sampled zero leaks is incomplete. Fast jobs and seven-minute unchanged-case handling weaken universal speed explanations. Synthetic observations prove no mechanism; assess next 40 exports against 12-minute median, 95% intended sets and zero foreign-center records.
